# Local Files for WSM ScoreHMR

This directory vendors the ScoreHMR source code plus WSM adapters. Large model
weights, generated caches, and logs are intentionally not committed.

## Required Local Files

### Official ScoreHMR data bundle

Download the official ScoreHMR data archive and extract it at the ScoreHMR root:

```bash
cd WSM_v1/third_party/ScoreHMR
gdown 1W53UMg8kee3HGRTNd2aNhMUew_kj36OH -O data.zip
unzip data.zip
```

This provides files such as:

- `data/model_weights/pare/pare_checkpoint.ckpt`
- `data/model_weights/score_hmr/model-100.pt`
- `data/model_weights/vitpose_ckpts/vitpose-h-multi-coco.pth`
- `data/SMPL_to_J19.pkl`
- `data/stats/pare_feat_stats.npz`
- `data/stats/prohmr_feat_stats.npz`

`data/model_weights/` is ignored because it is large.

### SMPL neutral model

The local WSG checkout already contains the SMPL neutral model:

```text
/research/cbim/vast/sf895/code/wsg/common/utils/human_model_files/smpl/SMPL_NEUTRAL.pkl
```

Create this symlink after extracting ScoreHMR data:

```bash
mkdir -p WSM_v1/third_party/ScoreHMR/data/smpl
ln -s /research/cbim/vast/sf895/code/wsg/common/utils/human_model_files/smpl/SMPL_NEUTRAL.pkl \
  WSM_v1/third_party/ScoreHMR/data/smpl/SMPL_NEUTRAL.pkl
```

`data/smpl/` is ignored because it is machine-local.

## Generated Files

### WSV-to-ScoreHMR datasets

The adapter builds ScoreHMR-style `.npz` files from WSV files:

```text
data/datasets/wsv_smpl_*.npz
```

These are generated by:

```bash
python wsm_adapters/build_wsv_smpl_dataset.py ...
```

They are ignored because they depend on the local WSV dataset.

### Cached PARE features

PARE image features are cached under:

```text
cache/pare/*.npz
```

These are generated by:

```bash
python wsm_adapters/cache_wsv_pare_feats.py ...
```

They are ignored because they are derived from the WSV dataset and PARE weights.

### Training logs and visualizations

Training outputs are written under:

```text
logs/
```

This includes TensorBoard files, PNG visualizations, and checkpoints for local
experiments. They are ignored.
